# The 6 Pass

> The 6 Pass is a yearly membership for Toronto. Members get two-for-one, or a free upgrade, at a short list of hand-picked restaurants, spas, studios and experiences. It opens on Tuesday, March 16, 2027. It is not open yet. The waitlist is open.

## Key facts

- Name: The 6 Pass
- Website: https://the6pass.ca
- City: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Opens: Tuesday, March 16, 2027, 9 a.m. Toronto time
- Status: pre-launch, waitlist open
- Contact: hello@the6pass.ca

## How it works

1. You get one pass, good for a year.
2. You pick a place in the app. Each offer shows the days it runs and how many times you can use it.
3. At the table or front desk you tap Redeem and show your code. Staff confirm it, and the second one is on the house.

## What offers cover

- Food, services and non-alcoholic drinks only.
- In person only. Not takeout or delivery.
- Restaurants and cafés: usually a second main.
- Spas: usually a free upgrade or add-on to a treatment.
- Studios: usually bringing a friend to class.
- Each partner sets its own offer, days and number of uses per member per year.

## Where it starts

Financial District, King West, Queen West, Ossington, Yorkville, Leslieville.

## How it differs from coupon sites

- No vouchers to buy, and none that run out.
- A short, hand-picked list. The 6 Pass is choosing 50 Founding Partners.
- Built for going back to places you like.

## Pricing

Not announced yet. Waitlist members get founding member pricing.

## For owners

The 6 Pass is choosing 50 Founding Partners. It is free for a partner's first 12 months, and the partner sets the offer, the days and the limits. Contact: hello@the6pass.ca
